paper_title: Emission of Single and Few Electrons in XENON1T and Limits on Light Dark Matter
notes: Paper sets 90% CL limits on dark photon dark matter absorption (kinetic mixing chi) and solar dark photons, plus DM-electron scattering, dipole/anapole interactions, and ALPs. The dark photon limits (Figures 15 top and 16) are the claimed 'new parameter space'. However, no numerical values or data tables are present in the provided text — all limits are shown only in figures. Cannot extract reliable (mass, coupling) pairs.
